notes: Rust idiom confidence: 85% chance of no missed issue. Least confident flags: (1) PKIX-841.26 (has_key_cert_sign Option<bool>) — private function, the Option<bool> is defensible given the clear doc comment; borderline between type-design finding and opinion. (2) PKIX-841.29 (From trait for TrustAnchor) — depends on whether from_cert signature change (PKIX-841.21) lands first; if from_cert stays owned, From<Certificate> is trivially derivable. Uncertainty driven by: no cargo clippy run against the actual code to confirm which clippy lints fire; the .as_ref().map() finding (PKIX-841.22) and for-iter (PKIX-841.23) are confirmed by reading but not verified to trigger clippy::needless_borrow / clippy::explicit_iter_loop.
title: Review: pkix-path public API and RFC 5280 implementation
